package r4id_test

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json/jsontext"
	json "encoding/json/v2"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	calc "example.com/r4id/gen/calc"
	client "example.com/r4id/gen/jsonrpc/calc/client"
	server "example.com/r4id/gen/jsonrpc/calc/server"
	loomhttp "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/http"
	"github.com/CaliLuke/loom/jsonrpc"
	loom "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/pkg"
)

type service struct {
	calls int
	last  string
}

func TestEnvelopeID(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name       string
		method     string
		params     string
		envelope   string
		wantCode   int
		wantResult string
		wantCalls  int
	}{
		{"required-envelope-only", "fmt", "{\"v\": \"x\"}", "\"6ba7b810-9dad-11d1-80b4-00c04fd430c8\"", 0, "id=6ba7b810-9dad-11d1-80b4-00c04fd430c8", 1},
		{"required-invalid-envelope-valid-spoof", "fmt", "{\"v\": \"x\", \"id\": \"6ba7b810-9dad-11d1-80b4-00c04fd430c8\"}", "\"not-a-uuid\"", -32602, "", 0},
		{"optional-invalid-envelope", "pat", "{\"v\": \"x\"}", "\"ABC\"", -32602, "", 0},
		{"nonnullable-null-id", "plain", "{}", "null", -32602, "", 0},
		{"required-nullable-null", "required-nullable", "{}", "null", 0, "null", 1},
		{"required-nullable-absent", "required-nullable", "{}", "", 0, "", 0},
		{"nullable-default-null", "nullable-default", "{}", "null", 0, "null", 1},
		{"nullable-default-absent", "nullable-default", "{}", "", 0, "id=fallback", 1},
		{"custom-codec", "custom", "{}", "\"2026-10-13T00:00:00Z\"", 0, "id=2026-10-13T00:00:00Z", 1},
		{"nullable-null", "nullable", "{}", "null", 0, "null", 1},
		{"nullable-absent", "nullable", "{}", "", 0, "absent", 1},
		{"default-absent", "defaulted", "{}", "", 0, "id=fallback", 1},
		{"default-empty", "defaulted", "{}", "\"\"", 0, "id=", 1},
		{"renamed-value", "renamed", "{}", "\"abc\"", 0, "id=abc", 1},
		{"named-alias", "alias", "{}", "\"abc\"", 0, "id=abc", 1},
		{"named-alias-invalid", "alias", "{}", "\"ABC\"", -32602, "", 0},
		{"only-envelope", "only", "{}", "\"abc\"", 0, "id=abc", 1},
		{"selected-params", "selected", "\"value\"", "\"abc\"", 0, "id=abc", 1},
		{"large-numeric-id", "plain", "{}", "9007199254740993", 0, "id=9007199254740993", 1},
		{"supplied-empty-id", "plain", "{}", "\"\"", 0, "id=", 1},
		{"ordinary-valid-optional", "pat", "{\"v\": \"x\"}", "\"abc\"", 0, "id=abc", 1},
		{"required-notification-spoof", "fmt", "{\"v\": \"x\", \"id\": \"6ba7b810-9dad-11d1-80b4-00c04fd430c8\"}", "", 0, "", 0},
		{"optional-notification-spoof", "pat", "{\"v\": \"x\", \"id\": \"abc\"}", "", 0, "absent", 1},
		{"ordinary-invalid-params", "pat", "{}", "\"abc\"", -32602, "", 0},
		{"ordinary-valid-duplicated", "fmt", "{\"v\": \"x\", \"id\": \"6ba7b810-9dad-11d1-80b4-00c04fd430c8\"}", "\"6ba7b810-9dad-11d1-80b4-00c04fd430c8\"", 0, "id=6ba7b810-9dad-11d1-80b4-00c04fd430c8", 1},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			svc := &service{}
			mux := loomhttp.NewMuxer()
			server.Mount(mux, server.New(calc.NewEndpoints(svc), mux, loomhttp.RequestDecoder, loomhttp.ResponseEncoder, func(_ context.Context, _ http.ResponseWriter, err error) {
				if err == nil {
					t.Error("nil diagnostic")
				}
			}))
			request := "{\"jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",\"method\":\"" + tc.method + "\",\"params\":" + tc.params
			if tc.envelope != "" {
				request += ",\"id\":" + tc.envelope
			}
			request += "}"
			response := httptest.NewRecorder()
			mux.ServeHTTP(response, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/rpc", strings.NewReader(request)))
			if response.Code != http.StatusOK {
				t.Errorf("HTTP status = %d, want 200", response.Code)
			}
			data := response.Body.Bytes()
			if tc.envelope == "" {
				if len(data) != 0 {
					t.Errorf("notification returned body: %s", data)
				}
			} else {
				var wire struct {
					ID     jsontext.Value `json:"id"`
					Result string         `json:"result"`
					Error  *struct {
						Code    int    `json:"code"`
						Message string `json:"message"`
					} `json:"error"`
				}
				if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &wire); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				if string(wire.ID) != tc.envelope {
					t.Errorf("response ID = %s, want %s", wire.ID, tc.envelope)
				}
				code := 0
				if wire.Error != nil {
					code = wire.Error.Code
					if wire.Error.Message == "" {
						t.Error("error has no detail")
					}
				}
				if code != tc.wantCode || wire.Result != tc.wantResult {
					t.Errorf("wire = %s, want code %d result %q", data, tc.wantCode, tc.wantResult)
				}
			}
			if tc.envelope == "" && svc.last != tc.wantResult {
				t.Errorf("notification payload ID = %q, want %q", svc.last, tc.wantResult)
			}
			if svc.calls != tc.wantCalls {
				t.Errorf("service calls = %d, want %d", svc.calls, tc.wantCalls)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestClientIDHasOneWireLocation(t *testing.T) {
	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/rpc", nil)
	const id = "6ba7b810-9dad-11d1-80b4-00c04fd430c8"
	if err := client.EncodeFmtRequest(loomhttp.RequestEncoder)(req, &calc.FmtPayload{ID: id, V: "x"}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer func() {
		if err := req.Body.Close(); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
	}()
	var wire struct {
		ID     string                    `json:"id"`
		Params map[string]jsontext.Value `json:"params"`
	}
	if err := json.UnmarshalRead(req.Body, &wire); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if wire.ID != id {
		t.Errorf("envelope ID = %q, want %q", wire.ID, id)
	}
	if _, exists := wire.Params["id"]; exists {
		t.Error("client duplicates ID in params")
	}
	if string(wire.Params["v"]) != "\"x\"" {
		t.Errorf("ordinary params changed: %v", wire.Params)
	}
}

func TestClientIDCarriers(t *testing.T) {
	text := "abc"
	alias := calc.Correlation(text)
	stamp := time.Date(2026, 10, 13, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name    string
		encode  func(*http.Request, any) error
		payload any
		want    string
	}{
		{"nullable-absent", client.EncodeNullableRequest(loomhttp.RequestEncoder), &calc.NullablePayload{}, ""},
		{"nullable-null", client.EncodeNullableRequest(loomhttp.RequestEncoder), &calc.NullablePayload{ID: loom.NullValue[string]()}, "null"},
		{"nullable-value", client.EncodeNullableRequest(loomhttp.RequestEncoder), &calc.NullablePayload{ID: loom.NullableValue(text)}, `"abc"`},
		{"default-native-zero", client.EncodeDefaultedRequest(loomhttp.RequestEncoder), &calc.DefaultedPayload{}, ""},
		{"default-value", client.EncodeDefaultedRequest(loomhttp.RequestEncoder), &calc.DefaultedPayload{ID: text}, `"abc"`},
		{"renamed", client.EncodeRenamedRequest(loomhttp.RequestEncoder), &calc.RenamedPayload{Correlation: &text}, `"abc"`},
		{"alias", client.EncodeAliasRequest(loomhttp.RequestEncoder), &calc.AliasPayload{ID: &alias}, `"abc"`},
		{"only", client.EncodeOnlyRequest(loomhttp.RequestEncoder), &calc.OnlyPayload{ID: &text}, `"abc"`},
		{"custom", client.EncodeCustomRequest(loomhttp.RequestEncoder), &calc.CustomPayload{ID: &stamp}, `"2026-10-13T00:00:00Z"`},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/rpc", nil)
			if err := tc.encode(req, tc.payload); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			defer func() {
				if err := req.Body.Close(); err != nil {
					t.Error(err)
				}
			}()
			var wire struct {
				ID     jsontext.Value            `json:"id"`
				Params map[string]jsontext.Value `json:"params"`
			}
			if err := json.UnmarshalRead(req.Body, &wire); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if string(wire.ID) != tc.want || jsonrpc.IsClientNotification(req) != (tc.want == "") {
				t.Errorf("ID=%s notification=%v, want %s", wire.ID, jsonrpc.IsClientNotification(req), tc.want)
			}
			if _, exists := wire.Params["id"]; exists {
				t.Error("params duplicates envelope ID")
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestCLIEnvelopeID(t *testing.T) {
	if _, err := client.BuildAliasPayload(`{}`, `null`); err == nil {
		t.Error("CLI accepts nonnullable alias null")
	}
	if _, err := client.BuildOnlyPayload(`null`); err == nil {
		t.Error("CLI accepts nonnullable native null")
	}
	if _, err := client.BuildFmtPayload(`{"v":"x"}`, "not-a-uuid"); err == nil {
		t.Error("CLI accepts invalid UUID")
	}
	if _, err := client.BuildAliasPayload(`{}`, `"ABC"`); err == nil {
		t.Error("CLI discards inherited ID pattern")
	}
	if got, err := client.BuildAliasPayload(`{}`, `"abc"`); err != nil || got.ID == nil || *got.ID != "abc" {
		t.Errorf("CLI alias = %+v, %v", got, err)
	}
	if got, err := client.BuildNullablePayload(`{}`, "null"); err != nil || !got.ID.IsNull() {
		t.Errorf("CLI supplied null = %+v, %v", got, err)
	}
	if got, err := client.BuildNullablePayload(`{}`, ""); err != nil || got.ID.Present() {
		t.Errorf("CLI absent = %+v, %v", got, err)
	}
	if got, err := client.BuildNullableDefaultPayload(`{}`, "null"); err != nil || !got.ID.IsNull() {
		t.Errorf("CLI default overwrote null = %+v, %v", got, err)
	}
	if got, err := client.BuildOnlyPayload(`"abc"`); err != nil || got.ID == nil || *got.ID != "abc" {
		t.Errorf("CLI ID-only = %+v, %v", got, err)
	}
}

func (s *service) Fmt(_ context.Context, p *calc.FmtPayload) (string, error) {
	s.calls++
	s.last = "id=" + p.ID
	return s.last, nil
}

func (s *service) Pat(_ context.Context, p *calc.PatPayload) (string, error) {
	s.calls++
	if p.ID == nil {
		s.last = "absent"
		return s.last, nil
	}
	s.last = "id=" + *p.ID
	return s.last, nil
}

func (s *service) Plain(_ context.Context, p *calc.PlainPayload) (string, error) {
	s.calls++
	s.last = "absent"
	if p.ID != nil {
		s.last = "id=" + *p.ID
	}
	return s.last, nil
}

func (s *service) Defaulted(_ context.Context, p *calc.DefaultedPayload) (string, error) {
	s.calls++
	s.last = "absent"
	s.last = "id=" + p.ID
	return s.last, nil
}

func (s *service) Renamed(_ context.Context, p *calc.RenamedPayload) (string, error) {
	s.calls++
	s.last = "absent"
	if p.Correlation != nil {
		s.last = "id=" + string(*p.Correlation)
	}
	return s.last, nil
}

func (s *service) Alias(_ context.Context, p *calc.AliasPayload) (string, error) {
	s.calls++
	s.last = "absent"
	if p.ID != nil {
		s.last = "id=" + string(*p.ID)
	}
	return s.last, nil
}

func (s *service) Only(_ context.Context, p *calc.OnlyPayload) (string, error) {
	s.calls++
	s.last = "absent"
	if p.ID != nil {
		s.last = "id=" + string(*p.ID)
	}
	return s.last, nil
}

func (s *service) Selected(_ context.Context, p *calc.SelectedPayload) (string, error) {
	s.calls++
	s.last = "absent"
	if p.ID != nil {
		s.last = "id=" + string(*p.ID)
	}
	return s.last, nil
}

func (s *service) Nullable(_ context.Context, p *calc.NullablePayload) (string, error) {
	s.calls++
	s.last = "absent"
	if p.ID.IsNull() {
		s.last = "null"
	} else if value, present := p.ID.Value(); present {
		s.last = "id=" + value
	}
	return s.last, nil
}

func (s *service) RequiredNullable(_ context.Context, p *calc.RequiredNullablePayload) (string, error) {
	s.calls++
	s.last = "absent"
	if p.ID.IsNull() {
		s.last = "null"
	} else if value, present := p.ID.Value(); present {
		s.last = "id=" + value
	}
	return s.last, nil
}

func (s *service) NullableDefault(_ context.Context, p *calc.NullableDefaultPayload) (string, error) {
	s.calls++
	s.last = "absent"
	if p.ID.IsNull() {
		s.last = "null"
	} else if value, present := p.ID.Value(); present {
		s.last = "id=" + value
	}
	return s.last, nil
}

func (s *service) Custom(_ context.Context, p *calc.CustomPayload) (string, error) {
	s.calls++
	s.last = "absent"
	if p.ID != nil {
		s.last = "id=" + p.ID.Format(time.RFC3339)
	}
	return s.last, nil
}
